notes: Three arms over the identical provider/model/judging config in longmemeval-smoke.json — the memory backend is the only delta.
openai-compatible is the runner path this pack fully supports (see src/packs/longmemeval/README.md); opencode is partial.
The akm arm needs the real akm CLI reachable (AKM_EVAL_AKM_CMD, default ["akm"]); see docs/memory-backends.md.

CAVEAT: the longmemeval pack adapter does not currently call memory.add()/memory.search() at all -- every question is answered from the full conversation history placed directly in the prompt regardless of backend. Until the pack is wired to retrieve through the backend, these three arms will score identically; this config exercises the akm backend's reset() path per arm and is the shape to extend once retrieval is wired in.
